inputs.text: This story about DHS announcing the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after New York City let him go despite the danger is just another scripted move by the elites and their institutions. They're pushing this narrative of tensions and sanctuary policies versus federal enforcement to manufacture fear and division, all while hiding how these same forces coordinate behind the scenes to release threats on purpose and then step in with arrests as cover. It's not about public safety at all—the whole thing serves their agenda of tightening control and keeping everyone distracted from the real manipulation at work.
